army_rules.name: Pact of Blood
army_rules.rules_text:
Through acts of frenzied violence and unbound savagery, the World Eaters may open a rent in reality, allowing the daemons of Khorne to spill forth from that infernal domain.

When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select BLOOD LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

army_rules.name: Blessings of Khorne
army_rules.rules_text: If your Army Faction is WORLD EATERS, at the start of the battle round, you can make a Blessings of Khorne roll. To do so, roll eight D6. You can then use those dice to activate up to two Blessings of Khorne. Each Blessing of Khorne specifies the dice results it requires, and the selected Blessing applies until the end of the battle round.

options.name: Unbridled Bloodlust
options.rules_text: This unit has +1 to charge rolls.

options.name: Rage-fuelled Invigoration
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".

options.name: Total Carnage
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

options.name: Martial Excellence
options.rules_text: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

options.name: Warp Blades
options.rules_text: Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

options.name: Decapitating Strikes
options.rules_text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack that targets an INFANTRY unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
